title: Elifusa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:2: he gave tithe to Rabbi Shimon bar Abba and told him, “They have been properly tithed.” Rabbi Shimon bar Abba asked Rabbi Yochanan, who said: “Our brother Elifusa is trustworthy.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The matching Guggenheimer digital paragraph is Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1, while Hyman supplies 1:2. It names Eilopusa giving tithe to Rabbi Shimon bar Abba and assuring him it is tithed; the recipient then asks Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman’s Elifusa spelling and original locator are retained alongside the matching location. The saved 1:2 comparison did not confirm this occurrence.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Terumot paragraph is at 1:1 and names Eilopusa giving tithe to Rabbi Shimon bar Abba, followed by Rabbi Yochanan’s assurance of trustworthiness. Hyman’s supplied 1:2 and Elifusa spelling remain visible; the difference does not authorize a source-text repair.
